tint2rc:
panel_items = LT
panel_position = bottom center horizontal
panel_size = 100% 36
panel_padding = 8 4 8
strut_policy = follow_size
taskbar_mode = single_desktop
task_icon = 1
task_text = 0
task_tooltip = 0
task_thumbnail = 0
task_maximum_size = 36 28
mouse_left = toggle_iconify
mouse_right = maximize_restore
launcher_icon_size = 24
launcher_tooltip = 0
launcher_item_app = /usr/share/applications/thunar.desktop
launcher_item_app = /usr/share/applications/xfce4-terminal.desktop
matrix-browser-lab-desktop.service:
[Unit]
Description=Matrix test cloud desktop icons and files
Requires=matrix-browser-lab-vnc.service
After=matrix-browser-lab-vnc.service matrix-browser-lab-wm.service
[Service]
User=matrix
Group=matrix
Environment=DISPLAY=:7
ExecStart=/usr/bin/dbus-run-session -- /usr/bin/xfdesktop
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=3
MemoryMax=512M
TasksMax=128
NoNewPrivileges=true
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
matrix-browser-lab-panel.service:
[Unit]
Description=Matrix test cloud desktop recovery panel
Requires=matrix-browser-lab-vnc.service
After=matrix-browser-lab-vnc.service matrix-browser-lab-wm.service
[Service]
User=matrix
Group=matrix
Environment=DISPLAY=:7
ExecStart=/usr/bin/tint2 -c /opt/matrix-browser-lab/tint2rc
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=3
MemoryMax=128M
TasksMax=64
NoNewPrivileges=true
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
matrix-browser-lab-chrome.service:
[Unit]
Description=Matrix test headed Chrome and persistent owner profile
Requires=matrix-browser-lab-vnc.service
After=matrix-browser-lab-vnc.service matrix-browser-lab-wm.service
StartLimitIntervalSec=60s
StartLimitBurst=5
[Service]
User=matrix
Group=matrix
Environment=DISPLAY=:7
ExecStart=/usr/bin/dbus-run-session -- /usr/bin/google-chrome-stable --no-first-run --no-default-browser-check --disable-dev-shm-usage --remote-debugging-address=127.0.0.1 --remote-debugging-port=9222 --user-data-dir=/home/matrix/.local/share/matrix-browser-lab/chrome --start-maximized --restore-last-session chrome://newtab
ExecStop=/opt/matrix/runtime/node/bin/node /opt/matrix-browser-lab/app/chrome-graceful-stop.mjs ${MAINPID}
TimeoutStopSec=20s
Restart=always
RestartSec=3
KillMode=control-group
MemoryMax=3G
TasksMax=512
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
